B also wants to maximize distinct tasks and minimize total cost. So B will also aim for a pair that yields cost 20. If B chooses T4, then A should choose T1 to get cost 20. If B chooses T1, A should choose T4. If B chooses something else, we might get higher cost.

However if there are multiple optimal outcomes (both cost 20), they might prefer one with higher personal reward.
